Checklist Item: Skip links implemented
Comments: 2026-11-23: No skip-to-main link found in the corporate homepage DOM or keyboard navigation structure.

Checklist Item: Lighthouse accessibility score >= 90 in Browser Audit Lighthouse panel; zero critical (wcag2a/wcag2aa) accessibility violations reported; all flagged items reviewed and addressed or documented
Comments: Desktop and mobile accessibility 95/100. Unresolved serious WCAG A link-name violation on footer LinkedIn link; heading-order also fails. No critical-impact violations reported; score alone does not establish WCAG compliance.

Checklist Item: No inline scripts without nonce/hash (CSP compliant)
Comments: Two executable inline scripts observed without nonce; main document has no enforcing CSP header to authorize hashes.

Checklist Item: Form actions use HTTPS only
Comments: All five observed form actions on homepage and Contact page use HTTPS. Scope: anonymous public pages; no submissions made.

Checklist Item: Lazy loading for below-the-fold images
Comments: Below-fold building and stewardship images use loading=lazy. Hero also uses lazy loading and is separately flagged by Lighthouse LCP discovery.

Checklist Item: CSS delivery optimized
Comments: Lighthouse flags render-blocking CSS and about 41-42 KiB unused CSS savings. Browser CSS coverage reports 99.2% unused base stylesheet and 91.7% unused site stylesheet on initial load.

Checklist Item: Unused JS removed
Comments: Lighthouse estimates 128 KiB unused JavaScript savings on both devices; flagged scripts include OneTrust SDK and Adobe Launch and jQuery.

Checklist Item: Meta description tag present on all pages; content between 50-160 characters; not a default placeholder value (e.g. 'description' / 'website' / 'page')
Comments: No meta description element on either sampled page: corporate homepage and Contact. Site-wide coverage not claimed.

Checklist Item: Favicon (<link rel="icon">) present in <head>; Apple touch icon present where applicable
Comments: PNG favicon link present in head and loaded successfully. No Apple touch icon observed; PWA or iOS installation scope not established.

Checklist Item: Canonical URL (<link rel="canonical">) present on all indexable pages; href is absolute URL; no duplicate canonical tags per page
Comments: Exactly one absolute HTTPS canonical on each sampled page; canonical uses www.jupiteram.com. This confirms tag presence only on homepage and Contact; canonical destination consistency not audited site-wide.

Checklist Item: Alternate language annotations (hreflang) present for multilingual sites; each hreflang is valid BCP 47 tag; x-default fallback present
Comments: Only x-default alternate found on homepage; no language-specific hreflang annotations despite country and language selector. HTML lang is en-GB.

Checklist Item: CSS <link> and <style> tags appear before <script> tags in <head> section; no JavaScript-only <script> inserted before stylesheet <link>
Comments: Adobe RUM script appears before first stylesheet in head. It is deferred but does not satisfy the checklist's explicit ordering requirement.

Checklist Item: External links with target="_blank" include rel="noopener noreferrer" to prevent tab nabbing and referrer leakage
Comments: Three new-tab investor-site links have empty rel attributes; Cookiepedia new-tab link has noopener only. Requirement explicitly includes both noopener and noreferrer; this is a markup finding rather than a demonstrated exploit.

Checklist Item: Custom error pages for 404 and 5xx HTTP responses exist in source; error pages include site branding and navigation back to homepage
Comments: Nonexistent corporate URL redirected to corporate homepage with final HTTP 200 rather than an identifiable branded 404 response. Source and 5xx handling not available for browser-only verification; no server errors deliberately induced.

Checklist Item: Webfont files use WOFF2 as primary format with WOFF fallback; @font-face declarations include format() hints matching served file types
Comments: Poppins Regular/SemiBold/Bold served as TTF fonts; CSS uses format(truetype). No WOFF2 primary or WOFF fallback in inspected font-face declarations.

Checklist Item: Lighthouse performance score >= 90 on desktop and >= 90 on mobile; run via Browser Audit Lighthouse panel (Audits tab) with device and throttling set appropriately
Comments: Lighthouse CLI 13.6.0: desktop preset 87/100; default simulated-throttling mobile 52/100. Single lab run per device on 2026-11-23; not field data.

Checklist Item: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) < 2.5s; CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) < 0.1; INP (Interaction to Next Paint) < 200ms; verify via Browser Audit Performance panel recording or Lighthouse Core Web Vitals section
Comments: Desktop LCP 2.03s and CLS 0.001; mobile LCP 8.8s and CLS 0.037. Mobile LCP exceeds 2.5s. Three sampled desktop menu interactions max 24ms Event Timing; not representative field INP and not a CWV certification.

Checklist Item: No JavaScript long tasks (> 50ms) blocking the main thread during page load; Total Blocking Time (TBT) within budget; verify via Browser Audit Performance panel Main thread flame chart and Lighthouse TBT metric
Comments: Lighthouse: desktop TBT 140ms with one 188ms long task; mobile TBT 720ms with four long tasks up to 1261ms. CSRF helper includes a 726ms mobile task; synchronous XHR deprecation also reported.

Checklist Item: Time to First Byte (TTFB) < 800ms measured in Browser Audit Network panel Timing tab; no excessive DNS lookup or TCP/TLS connection time in waterfall
Comments: Observed browser request-to-first-byte 681.4ms; Lighthouse server response 36ms desktop and 22ms mobile. Results are cache/location dependent and cover sampled corporate homepage only.

Checklist Item: Lighthouse SEO score >= 90 and Best Practices score >= 90 in Browser Audit Lighthouse panel; no critical findings blocking either category
Comments: Lighthouse desktop and mobile: SEO 77/100 and Best Practices 77/100. Missing description and JavaScript exceptions and deprecated synchronous XHR are documented findings.

Checklist Item: Total page weight within performance budget (< 1MB transferred for initial load); verify via Browser Audit Network panel Summary row showing transferred size, resource count, and finish time
Comments: Isolated cache-disabled desktop 1440x900 initial load to networkidle with scrollY=0: 1487473 transferred bytes across 48 completed requests; no network failures. Exceeds 1MB before scrolling. Lighthouse audit-window totals additionally measured 1698688 desktop and 1308444 mobile bytes.

Checklist Item: Text resources (HTML/CSS/JS) served with gzip or Brotli compression; verify via Content-Encoding response header in Browser Audit Network panel Headers tab for each critical resource
Comments: Fresh HTTP GETs confirm gzip for HTML and nonempty base/site CSS and site JavaScript. Empty dependencies stylesheet has no encoding; no payload to compress. Scope is sampled critical first-party resources.

Checklist Item: All images within size budget; no uncompressed PNG served where WebP/AVIF is available; image display dimensions match intrinsic dimensions (no oversized images scaled via CSS); verify in Browser Audit Network panel and Lighthouse image audit
Comments: Lighthouse image delivery estimates 532 KiB desktop and 186 KiB mobile savings. Desktop building image 1600x900 displayed 434x244; modern formats and responsive sizing recommended.

Checklist Item: Resources served over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 protocol; verify via Protocol column in Browser Audit Network panel (right-click column headers to enable Protocol column)
Comments: Main document and observed first-party assets negotiate h2. Lighthouse modern HTTP insight passes on desktop and mobile.

Checklist Item: JavaScript and CSS coverage on critical pages shows < 50% unused bytes on initial load; verify via Browser Audit Coverage panel (Ctrl+Shift+P > Show Coverage); flag unused bytes for lazy loading or removal
Comments: Playwright CSS coverage after networkidle: base CSS 99.2% unused and site CSS 91.7% unused. Lighthouse also flags unused JS. CSS alone exceeds the threshold; no pass inferred from coarse JavaScript function coverage.

Checklist Item: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) response header present with restrictive policy; no 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' directives without nonce/hash; verify in Browser Audit Network panel Response Headers for the main document request
Comments: No Content-Security-Policy response header on fresh main-document GET. Lighthouse CSP finding independently reports no CSP in enforcement mode.

Checklist Item: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present on all responses; X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors set to prevent clickjacking; Referrer-Policy header configured to restrict referrer leakage; verify all security headers in Browser Audit Network panel
Comments: Fresh first-party GETs include nosniff and X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN but no Referrer-Policy header. Cached browser response header set differs; all-response coverage not claimed.

Checklist Item: Zero JavaScript errors or unhandled promise rejections in Browser Audit Console panel on page load and during core user interactions; no CORS policy errors; console filter set to Errors level during production audit
Comments: Repeated production exceptions: null dataset/value accesses and MktoForms2 is not defined in site clientlib; undefined contains in base clientlib. Reproduced on reload and Contact navigation and Lighthouse.

Checklist Item: No deprecated browser API usage warnings or browser compatibility warnings visible in Browser Audit Console panel on production URL; Verbose level checked for hidden debug output
Comments: Lighthouse reports deprecated synchronous XMLHttpRequest on main thread in granite/jquery/granite/csrf clientlib. Browser debug output also observed.

Checklist Item: No mixed content warnings in Browser Audit Security panel; all sub-resources (scripts/styles/images/fonts/iframes) loaded over HTTPS; Security panel reports 'This page is secure (valid HTTPS)'
Comments: No HTTP subresource URLs in browser DOM or Lighthouse network records; no mixed-content warnings observed. MyJupiter navigation link uses HTTP but is not a loaded subresource; do not send credentials to that link without separately verifying its destination.

Checklist Item: TLS certificate valid and not expired; certificate chain complete and trusted by browser; verify in Browser Audit Security panel Certificate section; no certificate warnings on page load
Comments: Browser trusted connection with TLS 1.3 and Thawte EV RSA CA G2 issuer; certificate valid at audit time and no browser certificate warning. No certificate-ignore flags used.

Checklist Item: No sensitive data (auth tokens; PII; credentials; session secrets) visible in Browser Audit Application panel under Local Storage; Session Storage; IndexedDB; or Cookies; HttpOnly and Secure flags set on authentication cookies
Comments: NOT FULLY VERIFIED: Local and session storage had no keys and IndexedDB had no databases in anonymous session; affinity cookie Secure/HttpOnly/Lax. Authenticated-session storage and cookie payload sensitivity not established. Do not infer sensitive-data absence from cookie names alone.

Checklist Item: Cookies used for session management have SameSite attribute set to Strict or Lax; Secure flag enforced on all auth cookies; no unencrypted sensitive values in cookie payloads; verify in Browser Audit Application > Storage > Cookies
Comments: NOT FULLY VERIFIED: Anonymous affinity cookie has Secure and HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax. Analytics and consent cookies are Lax without Secure. No authenticated workflow tested and cookie payload sensitivity not established.

Checklist Item: Page layout tested at standard breakpoints using Browser Audit Device Toolbar responsive mode: 320px; 375px; 768px; 1024px; 1440px; no horizontal scrollbar at any mobile width; no content overflow or clipping detected
Comments: Tested all five widths. Document scrollWidth 326px at 320px and 381px at 375px; statistics blocks exceed viewport by 6px. No document horizontal overflow at 768/1024/1440; search box bounds also extend outside viewport at 1024.

Checklist Item: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) < 0.1 verified in Browser Audit Performance panel recording; no unexpected layout shifts after fonts load or lazy-loaded images render; individual shift scores inspected in Experience section of timeline
Comments: Lighthouse measured desktop CLS 0.001 and mobile CLS 0.037; both below 0.1. Shift culprits include cookie banner and header; pass is limited to recorded lab load windows rather than zero lifetime shifts.

Checklist Item: No render-blocking resources identified in Browser Audit Lighthouse report or Performance panel waterfall; third-party scripts do not appear in critical rendering path; async/defer attributes confirmed in Network timeline
Comments: Lighthouse render-blocking insight fails: estimated desktop savings 60ms and mobile 170ms. First-party stylesheet requests and blocking dependencies script observed; not all scripts are async/defer.

Checklist Item: No console.log or developer debug output active on production build; Browser Audit Console panel shows zero developer messages at Verbose/Info level when auditing production URL
Comments: Production logs include object; Script loaded and running; Ready to change period color; Contact navigation also emits Search endpoint requested at debug level.

Checklist Item: No 'Violation' messages (handler took Xms; forced reflow while executing) in Browser Audit Console panel during user interactions; violations indicate long-running event handlers or layout thrashing caused by interleaved DOM reads and writes
Comments: No Violation console messages during sampled desktop navigation-menu clicks and scrolling. Separate JavaScript errors and Lighthouse load long tasks are recorded as failures elsewhere; this pass is only for the stated console-message check.

Checklist Item: No forced synchronous layouts (layout thrashing) visible in Browser Audit Performance panel flame chart; purple 'Recalculate Style' or 'Layout' blocks triggered inside JS call stacks flagged; scrolling and animation frames remain within 16ms budget
Comments: PARTIALLY VERIFIED: Lighthouse forced-reflow insight passes; sampled CDP menu/scroll trace had 292 layout/style events with max 0.255ms and none with JS stack. Complete animation-frame duration not captured; 16ms frame budget cannot be certified from layout timing alone.

Checklist Item: No excessive repaints on scroll or CSS transitions; verify via Browser Audit Rendering panel > Paint flashing checkbox; green flash areas should be minimal and not cover full-page regions on scroll
Comments: NOT FULLY VERIFIED: Scroll trace captured 186 Paint events with max 0.696ms and large paint clip bounds. Clip bounds do not prove actual damage/repaint area; visual paint-flashing review is still needed before pass or fail.

Checklist Item: No detached DOM nodes accumulating after component mount/unmount cycles or SPA route changes; verify via Browser Audit Memory panel > Take heap snapshot > filter by 'Detached'; zero detached HTMLElement nodes expected after GC
Comments: CDP detached-node inspection after explicit GC found nonzero retained DIV/A/BODY/SPAN/SCRIPT roots. Six menu cycles did not increase counters: documents 14; nodes 2005; listeners 117 before/after. Zero-detached criterion not met; no accumulating leak demonstrated or attributed.

Checklist Item: Preloaded resources (<link rel='preload'>) are consumed within the page load; no 'The resource was preloaded using link preload but not used within a few seconds' warnings in Browser Audit Console; unused preloads waste bandwidth and block the load event
Comments: No preload links in sampled homepage head and no unused-preload console warnings observed across load and menu/scroll samples. No positive preloading optimization claimed.

Checklist Item: Web fonts load without FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text); Performance panel film strip shows text visible during font load phase; font-display swap or optional strategy confirmed by absence of blank text frames in Network waterfall timing
Comments: Inspected Poppins font-face declarations omit font-display swap/optional. Lighthouse font-display insight fails; estimated savings 40ms desktop and 210ms mobile. Warm-session screenshots do not establish absence of FOIT.

Checklist Item: FCP (First Contentful Paint) < 1.8s and Speed Index < 3.4s on mobile throttled network; verify via Browser Audit Lighthouse panel or Performance panel timing markers; FCP marker visible in Network waterfall as vertical line
Comments: Default simulated-throttling mobile Lighthouse: FCP 2.4s and Speed Index 4.5s. Both exceed stated thresholds. Desktop FCP 0.8s and Speed Index 1.2s do not substitute for mobile results.

Checklist Item: No duplicate network requests for the same resource during page load; verify via Browser Audit Network panel sorted by Name column; duplicate URL entries indicate missing request deduplication or redundant script imports
Comments: Lighthouse network records: 49 desktop and 45 mobile requests; no repeated exact URL within either load. Additional audit fetches and reloads excluded from duplicate-load assessment.

Checklist Item: WebSocket connections (if used) use encrypted wss:// protocol only; no unencrypted ws:// connections visible in Browser Audit Network panel WS filter; sensitive data must not transit over unencrypted WebSocket channels
Comments: Not applicable to observed flow: no WebSocket connections captured with Network.webSocketCreated during reload and sampled interactions. No encrypted-WebSocket implementation claimed.

Checklist Item: No resources loaded from origins not listed in Content-Security-Policy; CSP violations visible in Browser Audit Console as 'Refused to load' messages; each violation indicates a policy misconfiguration or an unauthorized resource
Comments: No enforcing CSP exists to define permitted resource origins. Third-party resources include Scene7 and OneTrust and Adobe Launch; absence of Refused to load messages does not demonstrate origin allowlisting.
